Matt was the tech lead on a global platform modernization delivery for a financial services client. Matt was responsible for ensuring a safe environment setup, but he relied on the existing documentation rather than verifying those controls.

He did not audit who could trigger downstream jobs or email processes. He also did not verify whether production customer data had been masked or scrubbed, or implement compensating controls such as email interception. An offshore tester accidentally triggered an email job in UAT, sending communications containing unmasked production customer data to **thousands of real clients**.

The client nevertheless demanded that the tester be removed from the project. Matt described it as “a systemic failure that resulted in an individual consequence.”

His stated lesson was that “assumptions are risks in disguise.” IAM validation, environment verification, PII scrubbing, and risk ownership became day-one leadership responsibilities in his delivery approach.

At **Accenture’s** Liquid Studio, traditional training programs couldn’t keep pace with rapidly evolving AWS technologies. Engineers had gaps in cloud competency, and cloud adoption was slowing. As Cloud Native Architecture Lead, Matt led AWS Launchpad in collaboration with AWS from July **2018** through November **2019**. The program put practical application at the center. Matt delivered interactive workshops and hands-on labs that immersed engineers in real-world AWS environments. Engineers could work with the technologies they were learning, rather than stop at course material or exam preparation.

He also established cloud expert mentorship teams so participants had experienced practitioners to learn from. Group coaching sessions and knowledge-sharing workshops gave engineers opportunities to ask questions, exchange knowledge, and continue developing their cloud competencies. The structure combined a defined learning path with hands-on practice and mentor-based training.

More than **200 professionals earned AWS certifications**, including AWS Solutions Architect and DevOps Engineer certifications. The program accelerated AWS adoption and the launch of cloud-native initiatives at **Accenture**, while giving engineers practical training and ongoing access to cloud experts.
